scientific_status: evidence-informed stylized concept; no species-level reconstruction
scientific_context: Conifer architectural concept; geological period and taxon not established by this style experiment.
artistic_choices: Crown lean, exact near-whorl spacing, branchlet angles, needle grouping, palette and seven-meter display size are original art direction.
Solid narrow tetrahedral needle units summarize several fine needles at medium range; no anatomical fascicle count is claimed.
originality: All geometry and code were independently authored. RHS059/low_poly_items was studied only for visual hierarchy; no reference meshes, materials, code or images are included.

usage_profile.role: Single focal tree / sparse close-to-midground grove quality sample; not a mass-forest LOD
usage_profile.renderer: Three.js 0.180.0, opaque rough materials, no texture dependency
usage_profile.supported_inspection: Branch-to-fan and fan-to-needle grouping at medium range; not macro needle anatomy
usage_profile.frame_time_target: Not yet benchmarked; no FPS claim
usage_profile.lod: One authored quality sample only. A lower-detail far variant is a separate future decision.
usage_profile.geometry_budget_decision: Spend geometry on growth hierarchy and actual short narrow foliage, then measure. Old 2600-triangle cap does not apply. No subdivision is used to fill a ceiling.

sources.supports: Broad conifer context; not proof of a particular extinct needle arrangement
Visual study of primary/secondary/tertiary form hierarchy only; no licensed content reused

topology_notes: Every needle bundle is a closed four-face solid. Woody components are closed tapering lofts with purposeful buried growth junctions. No transparency, billboard cards, normals tricks or per-face random color.

description.en: Original conifer quality sample with structural boughs, asymmetric secondary fans, fine terminal shoots and short solid needle bundles.
